# OpenGuide AI Studio
> The Sovereign In-Browser AI Engineering Studio ($0 Forever)

OpenGuide is a 100% free, local-first interactive AI engineering curriculum and sovereign Python WebAssembly development environment. Architected by Adil Rafiq Dar (ARD).

## Core Architecture & Engine
- **In-Browser CPython Runtime:** Pyodide v0.26 WebAssembly executing inside dedicated Web Workers with a 15-second watchdog timer. Zero backend servers.
- **3D Spatial Vector Manifold:** High-performance Three.js spatial holodeck visualizing high-dimensional embeddings, PCA projections, cosine similarity metrics, and semantic clustering with zero memory leaks.
- **Frontier Transformer Mechanics:** Interactive multi-head attention visualizer, token residual stream tracer, autograd reverse-mode autodiff micrograd engine.
- **Local-First Cryptographic Persistence:** IndexedDB storage with optional AES-GCM 256-bit passphrase encrypted private GitHub Gist sync ($0 Rule) and W3C Verifiable Credentials (.jsonld) export.
- **20 Calibrated Design Themes:** 10 Dark and 10 Light themes meeting WCAG AAA color contrast ratios across OLED, Nordic, Cyberpunk, and Pure Paper palettes.

## Curriculum Tracks
- [Track 0: Absolute Zero (Foundations)](https://openguideforai.dpdns.org/track/0): Python syntax, memory models, tensor manipulation, and algorithmic thinking for machine learning.
- [Track 1: Vector Space & Embeddings](https://openguideforai.dpdns.org/track/1): Mathematical geometry of embeddings, cosine distance, vector search, dimensionality reduction.
- [Track 2: RAG & Autonomous Agents](https://openguideforai.dpdns.org/track/2): Retrieval-Augmented Generation, chunking, re-ranking, Model Context Protocol (MCP) JSON-RPC tooling.
- [Track 3: Production Evals & Security](https://openguideforai.dpdns.org/track/3): LLM evaluation suites, prompt injection defense, adversarial testing, hallucination mitigation.
- [Track 4: Frontier Attention & Systems](https://openguideforai.dpdns.org/track/4): Transformer self-attention, rotary position embeddings (RoPE), KV caching, speculative decoding.

## Interactive Labs & Tools
- [Spatial Holodeck](https://openguideforai.dpdns.org/holodeck): 3D vector manifold cluster slicer and spatial neural topology visualizer.
- [Synapse Lounge](https://openguideforai.dpdns.org/synapse): Interactive vector dot-product, neuron activation, and attention temperature playground.
- [Learner Portfolio](https://openguideforai.dpdns.org/portfolio): W3C verifiable credentials, achievement ledger, and cryptographic identity.
- [Sitemap](https://openguideforai.dpdns.org/sitemap.xml): Complete machine-readable route manifest.
